[USER] User is seeking to learn more about self-love.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended resources for self-love:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. "The Art of Loving" by Erich Fromm - Explores the concept of love, including self-love, and provides practical advice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. "The Gifts of Imperfection" by Brené Brown - A guide to wholehearted living, embracing self-love and acceptance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. "Radical Self-Love: A Guide to Loving Yourself and Living Your Dreams" by Gala Darling - Offers practical tips for cultivating self-love.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. "The Self-Love Experiment" by Shannon Kaiser - A 30-day program for cultivating self-love and improving well-being.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. "Tiny Buddha's Guide to Loving Yourself" by Lori Deschene - Insights and advice from various contributors on self-love.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. "The Body Is Not an Apology: The Power of Radical Self-Love" by Sonya Renee Taylor - Explores body acceptance and self-love.
